name: AdvancedEncryption.WE.OrderLock.unit_chain_escape
title: With the order (out, n2, w, n1), eight co-located cover flips on the clause slots of the 4-variable NAND Tseitin CNF reach the all-ones slot
statement: For the CNF of n1 = NAND(w, w), n2 = NAND(w, n1), out = NAND(n2, n2) with unit (out) and levels 0..3 = out, n2, w, n1, let CC d c d' mean: d and c agree below some L, c L b = true, c is all ones after L, d' flips the entry (L, b) of d and agrees with d elsewhere. Then the chain of eight CC steps listed in the statement, starting from the clause cubes (not w or not n1), (out), (not out or not n2), (n2 or w), (n2 or n1), ends in the all-ones program.
